_comment: Proposed by route-menu (2026-10-15) for the orchestrator to merge into migration/parity-exemptions.json. Measured with the `householder` scenario (Q1 → A): parity_check --mock householder on state default gave only these three differences (position 1, pixel 1, call 1).

rules.reason: The version line is centred (justify-content-center); the capture masked it as bullets ("••• ••••••• ••• ••••", four words as the clone's text since CR-Login-4), the bullets have other glyph widths than the clone's text, so only its horizontal offset differs (150 → 144). auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

The user's avatar was masked by the capture (img src removed, data-masked-src="user-image", TST rendered 38x38): the replayed reference shows a broken inline image in the inline-block avatar container, the clone the 38x38 neutral placeholder (Q-W2C-1), so the header and everything below it sit a sub-pixel lower/higher; no layout or position difference is reported and the diff is only text and icon edges of the menu rows and the separator line (1.28 %, hotspots on row text). Same artifact as CAPTURE-MASKED-IMAGE-HOUSEHOLDRELATIONS-SHIFT; bounded to < 2 % and to this route's report. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

callOrderFree.reason: The Version block's OnReady Get_RuntimeVersion starts while the app-start chain runs: on TST it went out before AfterInitialize (4470 ms vs 6814 ms), the clone's shell calls AfterInitialize right after SynchAppContext, before the lazily loaded screen mounts. Its place among the app-start calls depends on timing; counts and inputs are still compared. Same artifact as CALL-ORDER-APPSTART-RACE-LEGACYSHAREOBJECT. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

_merged: 2026-10-15 by the orchestrator (rules scoped with routeRegex): CAPTURE-MASKED-TEXT-VERSION-MENU, CAPTURE-MASKED-AVATAR-MENU-SHIFT, CALL-ORDER-APPSTART-RACE-VERSION-MENU
